results.title: FCC seeks feedback on carrier D2D interference concerns - Light Reading
results.snippet: Amid a plan to open nearly 500MHz of spectrum for direct-to-device (D2D), the FCC is seeking comments on mobile operators' concerns that operating D2D in certain bands will cripple the performance of their 5G networks. It will consider warnings raised by AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon that operating D2D services in two heavily used 5G bands – 2.5GHz and 3.45GHz – will cripple 5G network performance. *
